input: Submit expense reports from last quarter

keyUnknowns.whyItMatters: Knowing which expenses are included (all categories, specific trips, projects, or departments) determines how much work is involved and what needs to be gathered.
The submission platform or process (e.g., Concur, Expensify, paper forms, email) dictates the exact steps and format required.
Whether receipts and records are already collected or still need to be tracked down changes how much prep work comes before submission.
Whether this is just for the user alone or involves collecting reports from a team significantly changes the coordination effort needed.
A hard internal or finance-team deadline determines urgency and how tasks should be prioritised or sequenced.
If manager or finance approval is required before final submission, that adds dependencies and potential wait times to the plan.
Understanding what 'done' looks like — confirmation email, reimbursement received, report status marked closed — defines when the task is truly complete.

gold.taskDescription: Compile and submit all outstanding expense reports from the previous quarter through the appropriate process or system.

questions.title: Which expense categories or trips are included in this submission?
questions.description: Clarify the scope — whether this covers all expenses from last quarter or only specific projects, trips, or cost categories.

questions.title: Which system or tool do you submit expenses through?
questions.description: Identify the platform or process used for submission, such as Concur, Expensify, a spreadsheet emailed to finance, or paper forms.

questions.title: Have you already gathered all receipts and records?
questions.description: Determine the current state of the raw materials — whether everything is on hand or receipts still need to be located and compiled.

questions.title: Are you submitting for yourself or on behalf of a team?
questions.description: Establish who is involved — a solo submission versus collecting and consolidating reports from multiple people requires very different coordination.

questions.title: Is there a specific deadline set by your finance team?
questions.description: Identify any hard cutoff date that determines how urgently each step needs to be completed.

questions.title: Does a manager need to approve the report before submission?
questions.description: Clarify whether there is an approval step required, which would add a dependency and potential waiting period to the workflow.

questions.title: What does a successfully completed submission look like to you?
questions.description: Define the finish line — whether it is a confirmation number, a status change in the system, or reimbursement actually received.
